from sympy import symbols,solve,Rational
S,T=symbols('S T')
r=solve([S-10-3*(T-10),S+10-2*(T+10)],[S,T])
res=str(Rational(r[S],r[T]).p)+' : '+str(Rational(r[S],r[T]).q)
opts=['2 : 7', '7 : 2', '7 : 3', '3 : 7']
assert res == opts[2]
assert res != opts[0]
assert res != opts[1]
assert res != opts[3]

from fractions import Fraction as F
res=str(int(F(92)/(F(1044,10)-90)*F(5,18)**-1*0+F(92)/((F(1044,10)-90)*F(5,18))))+' seconds'
opts=['21 seconds', '26 seconds', '22 seconds', '23 seconds']

assert res != opts[0]

be=sum(x for x in v if x<m)
r=F(ab,be)
res=f'{r.numerator}/{r.denominator}'
opts=['62/25', '2/1', '1/1', '39/71']

assert res != opts[1]
assert res != opts[2]
assert res != opts[3]
